name: chess3d-ad-video
description: Remotion project that renders THE FINAL MOVE, the 3D Chess cinematic promo (vertical + landscape). Edit src/, then npm run render.

scripts.studio: npm run prepare-assets && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.still: npm run prepare-assets && remotion still src/index.ts AdLandscape out/still.png --frame=447
scripts.render: npm run prepare-assets && npm run render:vertical && npm run render:landscape
scripts.validate: node scripts/validate-video.mjs vertical out/3d-chess-cinematic-v2-vertical.mp4 && node scripts/validate-video.mjs landscape out/3d-chess-cinematic-v2-landscape.mp4
